note: Follow-up cadence. Every interval is configurable per campaign (campaign.followups overrides this file). A reply at ANY step cancels every pending follow-up for that lead - enforced in lib/followups.js and by a DB trigger in db/migrations/0003_functions.sql.

steps.label: Initial DM
steps.intent: Open a conversation with one specific observation and one relevant question.

steps.label: Follow-up #1 - short continuation
steps.intent: One or two lines that continue the original thought. Never 'just following up'. Re-state the specific observation in different words and make replying take five seconds.

steps.label: Follow-up #2 - business observation / value
steps.intent: Add something they did not have before: a concrete observation about how similar brands in their niche handle this, or a number from comparable work. No pitch deck, no service list.

steps.label: Final follow-up - close the loop
steps.intent: Respectful close-the-loop. Acknowledge the timing may be wrong, leave the door open, ask nothing more than a yes/no. This is the last automated touch.

rate_limits.note: Human-operated sending pace. The queue will not release more than this many messages per day per sending account.
